issues.text: The task expected criteria of REQ-111/REQ-112 about the fine line idea_panel_fine, the accuracy label demo_accuracy or a count of lines or panels, and a micro-amendment for each. There are none: a case-insensitive grep over the lines of REQ-111 and REQ-112 for the three keys and the whole words «Точность», «accuracy», «fine», «receipt» finds nothing, and no test of app/test or tools/test names these keys either. Only decisions/0123 О1 and Q4 touch the places, and both stay true. So result.changes lists no amendment, and REQ-111/REQ-112 stay byte for byte (their status done is not reopened). REQ-VALIDATOR should read the «Consistency with REQ-111 and REQ-112» paragraph and the guard table of the REQ-113 description and say if it disagrees.

Criterion 11 asks for the owner's answer «похоже» (the G21 pattern) before the release, because the change alters the look of two released screens and the look description is the measure of REQ-111 criteria 13 and 15. If ORCH decides that the owner's «Делай» already covers the look, strike the last sentence of criterion 11 in a rework step (it is a gate of this requirement only, not a check of REQ-111 or REQ-112).

The task named the layout widths «360-380 px, 390, 1470». The matrix of REQ-111 and of the code (WINDOWS in app/test/fixtures/e2e-kit.js) is 1470x784, 390x844 and 320x568; 360 to 380 appear only in LD-5's speaker row. Criterion 10 uses the matrix (so 320 is covered) and adds 360 and 380 for LD-6, where the design review says the rows turn into a column below 480 px.

Q12, a choice for the record: the reading that the marks «Работает» / «Пока нет» are no «status of any project» in the sense of REQ-112's text (decision 0083 item 7, decision 0097 item 1, the owner's «Никаких … выдуманных статусов»). The requirement states it in its description (the marks say which parts of the site exist, each true today, outside the scene; the scene takes no new parameter). Proposal: ORCH records one line in decisions/ (the next number) with this reading, or confirms it at the gate; REQ-112's text is not touched.

Left to the code design: the key idea_panel_fine is removed (criterion 1 says it is gone and a grep finds no use). If the design prefers to keep an unused key, criterion 1 and the script of criterion 9 need one word changed in a rework step. The key names are the working names of review-design.ru.md; the two keys for the accuracy sentence and the note of stage 1 have no name there, so the criteria say «the design gives» and the test rows follow the design.

No kk value is fixed in REQ-113: the 15 keys need kk drafts by the coding role, read by reader agents in two rounds (criterion 2, REQ-111 criterion 2). Any kk line that the rounds do not settle goes to the list of ISS-0127; kk stays hidden on production (G9).

Counts: criterion 13 states no number and no bound of its own beyond «not below the count of the last green app.yml run before this work». REQ-108 criterion 2 still points to «the test catalogue of the run, section 13 of the skeleton design» (ISS-0128 item 1, AP-170, open); REQ-113 does not rely on it and states the rule as a command form. CODE-DESIGNER must read the base counts from the job log (the release run recorded unit 120, int 47, e2e 15 in ISS-0128; the tree has moved since, so they must be read again, not copied).

`cd tools && npm run -s handoffs-check` reports 1 violation that is independent of this work: handoffs/M0DOCS-20261117-01/step-05c-test-designer.json:9 (H4, status PENDING in a commit). Not touched. The project has no YAML library, so the YAML load was a shape check of the block (see self_check), not a full parse; a full parse needs a library that is not installed on this computer.
